title: Vision Electric Boat Rental in Ventura
specs: No boating license required; easy to operate electric boats
Pet friendly with small pet fee
Scavenger hunt activity available during cruises
Drivers must be 21+ with a valid driver's license
No operating vessel under influence of alcohol or drugs
Pets under 25 lbs allowed with $25 cleaning fee; service animals exempt
Boats seat up to 8 or 10 people depending on model
gap: Exact rental duration options besides hourly not stated
blurb: Guests rent electric boats to cruise Ventura Harbor. Boats seat up to 10 people and are easy to operate like a golf cart. Membership options offer monthly fees for regular boating access.
extraNote: Membership requires 12-month contract, auto-renews unless canceled 20 days prior · $500 security deposit for membership, refundable if no damages or fees · Late returns charged double hourly rate · Vessels must be returned clean or cleaning fees apply · No refunds for early termination or non-compliance with rules · Ventura Harbor

quotes.author: LifeChase
quotes.text: Had a super smooth check in and out thanks to Austin really appreciate it . Made our day extra fun worry free . The EBoats were flawless easy to maneuver the guys at the dock were friendly as well .Will definitely come back to these guys .

quotes.author: Brenda Miller
quotes.text: We had a great time. It was a gift to us. The boats are clean and the staff is very nice. The only thing is, make sure to arrive early, the parking is not easy. We found it''s best to do Uber.

quotes.author: Dom Molina
quotes.text: From start to finish it was perfect. The boats a very clean and new and everyone working was very professional and welcoming. Big props to our boy Cooper for excellent customer service!

quotes.author: Kelvin Nodarse
quotes.text: Had an amazing time called in 2 hour’s before we actually arrived to the area same day and was able to get on the water. Great young staff who gets it!
